 Order(Oral)

 04. 1.

This matter is taken up through Hybrid Arrangement (Virtual/Physical Mode).
2.

This is a bail application U/S.483 of BNSS by the petitioner for grant of bail in connection with Jeypore Mahila PS Case No.70 of 2024 corresponding to GR Case No.590 of 2024 pending in the file of learned Additional Sessions Judge-Cum-Special Court under POCSO Act, Koraput At Jeypore,
for commission of offences punishable U/Ss.376(2)(n)/506/34 of IPC r/w Section 6 of POCSO Act,
on the main allegation of committing rape and aggravated penetrative sexual assault upon the victim.
3.

In the course of hearing, Mr. PVS Nanaji Achary, learned counsel for the petitioner appearing virtually submits that the petitioner is an innocent person since all the acts of the petitioner with the victim are consensual in nature and, thereby, the petitioner may kindly be granted bail.

3.1. On the other hand, Mr. C. Mohanty, learned Additional Public Prosecutor, however, opposes the bail application of the petitioner by contending inter-alia that the acts of the petitioner would squarely make him liable for offence U/S.6 of POCSO Act and, therefore, the bail application of the petitioner may kindly be rejected.

None appears for the informant/victim despite being duly intimated as apprised by learned Addl. PP.
4.

After having considered the rival submissions and taking into consideration the nature and gravity of the offences as alleged against the petitioner vis--vis the accusations sought to be brought against him and regard being had to the materials collected in support of the allegation against the petitioner and taking into account the other circumstances on record in entirety including the Nanda Kishore Barchi vs State Of Odisha ...

1 statement of the victim, this Court is not inclined to grant bail to the petitioner at this stage,
especially when the victim is yet to be examined.
5. Hence, the bail application of the petitioner stands rejected.
Accordingly, the BLAPL stands disposed of.
6. Issue urgent certified copy of the order as per Rules.
